title: Till sjöss
request: Accurately identified Finnish boating scene, no added navigational advice.

title: Paddling och segling
request: Distinct actual paddling or sailing photograph with source identity verified.

title: Säkerhet till sjöss
request: Watercraft and safety symbol, no equipment/procedure recommendation beyond the source context.

title: Väder och flytväst
request: Actual life jacket, ideally with neutral weather symbol; no fabricated forecast or claim that a photographed fit is correct.

title: Vattendrag fryser
request: Verified Finnish winter lake, no assurance that the ice supports people.

title: Aktiviteter på isen
request: Actual skating, skiing or ice-fishing image, contextualized by the source safety warnings, not endorsed as a safe location.

title: Risker på isen
request: Distinct visible lake-ice/crack photograph; no invented risk threshold or claim that appearance alone establishes safety.

title: Ta reda på hållbarheten
request: Unknown thickness/bearing capacity represented by question marks; no invented safe centimetre threshold.

title: Checklista
request: Pictorial ice-safety checklist limited to the next source statements; no additional survival advice.

title: Ny is bär inte genast
request: Accurately identified new/early-season lake ice; no numeric ice-strength claim.

title: Tjockleken kan variera
request: Qualitative ice cross-section varies over distance, without invented centimetre values or a safe/unsafe threshold.

title: Våris
request: Verified spring/rotting lake ice illustrating the source warning; no route recommendation.

title: Isdubbar
request: Actual ice-rescue picks accurately identified; do not substitute a climbing ice axe.

title: Ta sig ur en vak
request: Ice edge and rescue-pick symbols reflect the source difficulty statement without adding procedural self-rescue steps.

title: Osäker is
request: Uncertain bearing capacity leads to staying on land, exactly matching source; no invented measurement standard.
